name: Telmisartan / cardio protection on cycle

card.summary: Use of the blood pressure drug telmisartan by people on performance hormones to manage blood pressure and bloat, so they can keep training and hold a leaner, fuller look.
card.note: Prescription blood pressure drug; contraindicated in pregnancy. Use alongside hormones is discussed in forums and not studied in trials.

quick.overview:
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker prescribed for high blood pressure and cardiovascular risk reduction. In bodybuilding and looksmaxxing forums it is discussed as a way to manage blood pressure and water retention during hormone use, and some users call it a debloating or vasodilating aid.

The drug has strong trial evidence in hypertension and high-risk patients, but no published study has tested it in people using anabolic hormones. Forum opinion is divided on whether it does what users hope.
quick.how: Users in forums mention it as an oral once-daily tablet obtained with a prescription or through gray-market channels, sometimes alongside other cardiovascular-support supplements. This wiki does not give dosing or sourcing details.
quick.risks: Telmisartan is prescription-only in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and the EU and is contraindicated in pregnancy. Reported side effects include kidney problems, low blood pressure and angioedema. Blood pressure and cardiovascular effects of hormone use should be assessed with a clinician.

lead: Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) approved for hypertension and for reducing cardiovascular events in high-risk patients [1][2]. In bodybuilding and looksmaxxing forums it is discussed as a blood-pressure and bloat management tool for people using performance hormones, with the stated aim of staying healthy enough to keep training and keep a lean, dry physique.

The pharmacology cited by users includes its partial agonism of PPAR-gamma, described in the medical literature as a feature linked to insulin sensitivity and vascular and kidney protection [3][4]. Some forum users describe it as a mild vasodilator or debloating aid, while others challenge these claims [5][6].

Trial evidence concerns patients with hypertension or vascular disease: ONTARGET compared telmisartan with ramipril and TRANSCEND tested it in ACE-inhibitor-intolerant patients [7][8]. No published study has examined telmisartan in people using anabolic steroids or similar hormones.

chain: Telmisartan lowers blood pressure via AT1 receptor blockade
Users aim for less bloat and safer cardiovascular numbers on hormones
Able to keep training and retain a leaner look
angle.text: Users take it to manage blood pressure and puffiness during hormone use. The appearance payoff, as they describe it, is a drier, leaner look and continued training.

paras: Telmisartan blocks angiotensin II at the AT1 receptor and is also a partial PPAR-gamma agonist [1][3]. It is indicated for hypertension and for lowering heart attack, stroke and cardiovascular death risk in high-risk patients intolerant to ACE inhibitors [8][9]. In ONTARGET, it was compared with ramipril in a large high-risk population [7]. Reported adverse effects include kidney problems, low blood pressure and angioedema; it is contraindicated in pregnancy [1].

sections.h: Use in looksmaxxing and bodybuilding communities
paras: Posters on looksmax.org have asked whether telmisartan is an effective vasodilator compared with tadalafil to boost nutrient delivery to muscle while leaning out [10]. Another thread argues the opposite, asserting that its PPAR-gamma activity favors fat cells and that it is a weak blood pressure agent, rejecting its reputation as a debloating aid [5]. Wikipedia notes that speculation about PPAR-delta activity as a sport doping aid exists, with endurance effects seen in mice [1].
Network meta-analyses compare ARBs including telmisartan on blood pressure outcomes [11], and a large trial tested a telmisartan-containing low-dose triple pill [12]. None address hormone users.
No studies found in people using anabolic hormones. In patients with hypertension or vascular disease, trials include ONTARGET [7], TRANSCEND [8] and a 2024 Lancet trial of a triple pill [12].

lore.intro: Telmisartan is discussed in looksmax.org threads as a blood pressure and debloating aid [5][10].

claims.claim: Telmisartan acts as a debloater or vasodilator that helps users on hormones
claims.believers: Some users call it a mogger cardarine or debloating supplement and ask whether it improves nutrient supply to muscle [5][10].
claims.experts: Published trials test it for blood pressure and cardiovascular outcomes in patients; no study has tested it for bloat or muscle perfusion [7][1].

claims.claim: Telmisartan does little for blood pressure and promotes fat storage
claims.believers: A critical thread argues its PPAR-gamma activity increases fat cells and that it is not a potent ARB [5].
claims.experts: Clinical trials show blood pressure lowering comparable to other ARBs and ACE inhibitors in patients [7][11].
